claims.sourceText: Prepublication Review Information, CIA reading-room document C06712956, https://archive.org/download/cia-readingroom-document-06712956/06712956_djvu.txt
claims.text: Where the Board determines that a manuscript contains classified information, the guidance requires the author to return any and all versions of this work, in whatever form, for destruction and to remove those items from their hard drive, with CIA security personnel available to assist.

claims.sourceText: Prepublication Review Information, CIA reading-room document C06712956, https://archive.org/download/cia-readingroom-document-06712956/06712956_djvu.txt
claims.text: The released item includes an internal document dated 17 April 2013 headed Prepublication Review Procedures and marked SECRET//CIA INTERNAL USE ONLY//NOFORN, describing manuscript flow through a case assigner, a Team Lead, equity-holding Information Review Officers and a second reviewer.

claims.sourceText: Prepublication Review Information, CIA reading-room document C06712956, https://archive.org/download/cia-readingroom-document-06712956/06712956_djvu.txt
claims.text: The same guidance provides that if the Board upholds its decision on reconsideration the author may formally appeal in writing to the Board's Chairman within 30 days, and that such appeals go to the Agency's Associate Deputy Director for a final Agency decision.

claims.sourceText: Prepublication Review Information, CIA reading-room document C06712956, approved for release 2018/11/28, https://archive.org/download/cia-readingroom-document-06712956/06712956_djvu.txt
claims.text: The Board's released guidance states: Please allow at least 30 working days for completion of the review process.

edges.label: A board of the Agency, described in the Agency's own released guidance

edges.label: Requires every version of a manuscript surrendered for destruction and removed from the author's hard drive
edges.note: The guidance's own destruction and hard-drive removal provision is a documented custody mechanism operating on an author's text.

edges.label: A disclaimer disowning authentication is attached in advance to every cleared account
edges.note: The mandatory disclaimer required on every approved writing states that nothing in it implies US Government authentication of the information, which is a formal, self-documented denial attached in advance to every cleared account.
